chats.answer:
If you're looking for a 3D scanner to scan real-world objects and reproduce them with a 3D printer, I'd recommend a handheld structured-light or laser 3D scanner.

The basic workflow is:

Scan object

Edit 3D model

3D print

For 3D printing, prioritize scanning accuracy, ability to capture small details, and export to STL or OBJ. Also note that scanned models often need cleanup before printing.
